text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Finally, Mejiro Dober's debut race is<n>here! We're
just about to head out<n>so we can get to Niigata
Racecourse<n>early...
Oh, what perfect timing. Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've come to cheer you on, of course.<n>It would be
unacceptable for me to<n>miss my kindred spirit's
debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You came all this way for me?<n>...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Save your thank-yous untilyou've seen everyone who's cometo support you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Dober! Just stay relaxed<n>while you run,
and you won't have a<n>thing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Cheering for her is Mejiro Ryan, a<n>forerunner to
Dober who has<n>inherited the Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hear they've known each other<n>since Dober was
very young and are<n>practically like sisters.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Show us what all your training has<n>amounted to out
on the track. We're<n>expecting great things from
you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's the "Empress" Air Groove,<n>known for
being part of the<n>mother-daughter duo that
dominated<n>the Japanese Oaks, and also the<n>student
council vice president.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's also earned a reputation for<n>her caring
nature and frequently<n>mentored Dober before she
had a<n>trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan! Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't have... It's so far, and<n>I'm—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there! Look, we're all here<n>'cause we
want to see you race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You came to my debut, so now it's<n>my turn to cheer
you on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, really... I'm going to do<n>my best!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A spark shines bright in Mejiro<n>Dober's eyes, lit
by the kind support<n>of her friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you even have to ask? Of course I<n>am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...A little. Look, my hands are shaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm going to do this! I have to, for<n>everyone
who came to support me...
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. I believe in you.
You'll be fine. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm going to do this! I have to, for<n>everyone
who came to support me...
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. I believe in you.
You'll be fine. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hmph, you're always saying things<n>like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're always so<n>straightforward, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you mean it, then... just keep your<n>eyes on me,
and watch as I cross the<n>finish line.
